macos.rationale: Experimental Apple Silicon macOS Ventura+ client.

windows.rationale: The complete scoped desktop installation/download instructions support Apple Silicon macOS only; the linked robin/oswe CLI is installed by that Mac app, not a standalone Windows/Linux client.

linux.rationale: The complete scoped desktop installation/download instructions support Apple Silicon macOS only; the linked robin/oswe CLI is installed by that Mac app, not a standalone Windows/Linux client.

cli.rationale: Product-owned robin/oswe commands ship with desktop.

local.rationale: This Mac local bridge executes commands in the chosen folder; model loop still uses backend.

vendor-cloud.rationale: LangSmith cloud sandboxes execute thread work.

parallel-runs.rationale: Independent cloud threads or local worktrees run concurrently.

worktree.rationale: New worktree option separates local thread files.

coordinator.rationale: Robin-owned catalog supplies subagents and configurable models.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Scheduled system threads and inbound integrations initiate work.

multiplayer.rationale: Shared workspace/Slack participants may prompt collaborative threads.

roles.rationale: Global configured-admin and signed-in-user permissions; per-workspace roles deferred.

pr-workflow.rationale: Creates and updates PRs and publishes reviews.

review-ui.rationale: Changes tab renders a session diff.

license.rationale: MIT covers Robin code, excluding vendor/.

self-hosting.rationale: Core server and UI deploy on Docker; Managed Deep Agents dependency retained.

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: Deployment administrator disables optional PostHog/Segment by leaving keys unset.

android.rationale: The mobile client README says only iOS is supported, so there is no native Android client. Scope: Robin iOS client.

ios.rationale: The publicly available source includes an iOS development client with Xcode/Expo build instructions. This is source-built only, not an App Store or release binary; native toolchains are required.

mobile-web.rationale: The browser cloud-thread client explicitly provides a phone-width sidebar/chat layout. Owning-Mac restrictions still apply to bridged local threads.

free-tier.rationale: The desktop app and CLI are free downloads from GitHub releases, and the backend is MIT source. Model and sandbox costs are separate. Scope: Experimental Robin macOS Electron client and CLI.

starting-price.rationale: The app is a free download with no paid plan in the README, licence, releases or LangChain's sign-in page. Scope: Experimental Robin macOS Electron client and CLI.

claude-code.rationale: The scoped product runs its own Managed Deep Agents loop, not this coding-CLI harness. Claude Code sync is a read-only mirror, and model selection or catalog customization does not establish another harness.

laptop-independent.rationale: Cloud threads execute in backend-managed Deep Agents/LangSmith sandboxes, independently of the browser client. The This Mac bridge is excluded because quitting its owning app makes it unreachable.
